IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactUserLinkTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.ContactUserLinkTbl ( LinkID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_ContactUserLinkTbl PRIMARY KEY, UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, ContactID INT NOT NULL, MustChangePassword BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ContactUserLink_MustChangePassword DEFAULT (1), CreatedAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ContactUserLink_CreatedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()), LastLoginAt DATETIME NULL, CONSTRAINT UQ_ContactUserLink_UserId UNIQUE (UserId) );
CREATE INDEX IX_ContactUserLink_ContactID ON dbo.ContactUserLinkTbl (ContactID); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactPortalSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.ContactPortalSettingsTbl ( SettingsID INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_ContactPortalSettingsTbl PRIMARY KEY, EditableContactFields NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ContactPortalSettings_Fields DEFAULT (N'PhoneNumber,CellNumber,EmailAddress,AltEmailAddress'), UpdatedAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ContactPortalSettings_UpdatedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()), UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(128) NULL );
INSERT INTO dbo.ContactPortalSettingsTbl (SettingsID, EditableContactFields, UpdatedBy) VALUES (1, N'PhoneNumber,CellNumber,EmailAddress,AltEmailAddress', N'system'); END
